### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via emptyState (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via emptyState (literal, a string literal in sections))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0e87d4f470bf4d8b337c5dcce6106dcc2a2351aa` — the merge of head `524446de94d75a5287788e56dba7c380e36b74ab` into base `7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0e87d4f470bf4d8b337c5dcce6106dcc2a2351aa && git checkout 0e87d4f470bf4d8b337c5dcce6106dcc2a2351aa
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0 524446de94d75a5287788e56dba7c380e36b74ab && git checkout -B drift-repro 7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0 && git merge --no-ff 524446de94d75a5287788e56dba7c380e36b74ab

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7ffc57846a97afde24fbfc59b6b05d7562ef4df0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Scope of record: item 4 of the card alone, as the unlock scan left it.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No schema, accept set or refuse set moves — RIGHT.** The net diff touches 8 files: `page.form.ts` (+5), the reconciliation test (−7), four `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles (+4 each), the echo-decisions count pin (+4/−1) and one changeset. `git diff --stat` of the merge-base against the head over `packages/spec/src/ui/*.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness` and every `packages/spec/**/*.json` is empty. `InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState: EmptyStateSchema.optional()` already parsed on `main` (`page.zod.ts:936`), so every page valid before is valid now and nothing new is accepted or refused. The triage ruling "offering a declared key in a form changes no accept set" holds on this diff.
- **Renderer premise at the pin — VERIFIED, RIGHT.** `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` is `b9814b334d8aebac43dd2b04a2003963aec3cc6e`. Read at that sha via `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/contents/packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx?ref=b9814b334d8a…`: line 292 is `const cfg = page?.interfaceConfig || {};` and line 509 is `emptyState: cfg.emptyState ?? view.emptyState,` under the objectui#12270 comment block (`:503-508`). The deleted omit row's `why` ("no console list page draws it yet … measured at objectui 7af0ab3") is false at this pin, so deleting the row is the correct act, and the PR body's citation of `:292` / `:509` is accurate.
- **Form rows match `EmptyStateSchema` — RIGHT.** `EmptyStateSchema` (`view.zod.ts:1909`) declares exactly `title`, `message`, `icon`, `link` (its `aliases` / `guidance` are overlay, not keys; `link` is the module-private `emptyStateLinkSchema()` object). The new row is `{ field: 'emptyState', type: 'composite', disclosure: 'popover', helpText }` with no hand-written `fields`, the identical shape to its neighbours `appearance`, `userActions` and `addRecord`, so its sub-rows are schema-derived: no key is offered that the schema refuses, and none the schema declares is hand-omitted. The reconciliation test's `nestedLists` judges only hand-written lists, so the root `interfaceConfig` list is the one judged, and `emptyState` is now offered there. No other `InterfacePageConfigSchema` key is left unoffered without a ledger row (`sourceView` keeps its deprecated-omit row; every other key — `source`, `columns`, `sort`, `filterBy`, `levels`, `appearance`, `userFilters`, `userActions`, `addRecord`, `buttons`, `recordAction`, `showRecordCount`, `emptyState`, `allowPrinting` — is offered).
- **Regenerated bundles are generator output plus translations for exactly the new leaves — RIGHT.** Each of the four locales gains one entry, `"interfaceConfig.emptyState": { label, helpText }`, placed between `addRecord` and `buttons` in form order. The `en` `helpText` is byte-equal to the form's `helpText`; `zh-CN` (空状态), `ja-JP` (空の状態) and `es-ES` (Estado vacío) carry authored label and help text. No sub-row leaves are emitted, which matches the neighbours (`addRecord`, `appearance`, `userActions` carry no `.xxx` sub-leaves either). No provenance-table or extractor-fill entries appear in the diff.
- **668 → 669 count pin is the one new label row — RIGHT.** The positive control counts `.label` leaves present in a locale and differing from `en`; one new `interfaceConfig.emptyState.label` authored in all three locales moves it by exactly one. The added comment follows the file's running-ledger style (the preceding `668 since #22876` line). The pin is moved, not loosened (still `toBe`).
- **Reconciliation ledger deletion is clean — RIGHT.** The removed row was the only `page / interfaceConfig / emptyState` entry; no dangling ledger row remains, and the dev's ablation (anchor x1 → x0, red with `expected [ 'emptyState' ] to deeply equal []`, restored to HEAD blob `1b33812358`) is the correct proof shape for this change, as reported.
- **Liveness ledger and generated docs — nothing stale.** `packages/spec/liveness/page.json:70` already carries the `live` note citing `InterfaceListPage.tsx:509` from #23424; no "not offered in a form" sentence exists there to flip. `check:generated` is not in this diff's files and the `Spec property liveness` check-run is `success`.
- **File list vs os-dev-report — matches.** The eight `files_changed` in the report are the eight files of the PR's file list and of the merge-base diff.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/23395-page-form-empty-state.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `'@objectstack/platform-objects': patch`, with the `Clause-②: no` line and a per-package body. **RIGHT.** The published change is one added row on the exported `pageForm` layout and four translation leaves; no authorable key, export or stored shape moves, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed. Precedent on `main` for a form-only row with translations is `patch` on both packages (`approvalsVisibleToReaders`, `onSuccess`/`outcomeMessages`, `imageField`). No `skip-changeset`, and none would apply since the diff publishes. `Check Changeset` check-run: `success`.
- `Clause-②: no` — RIGHT. No public API or protocol surface widens or narrows; the console reads the same `interfaceConfig.emptyState` it read before.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation 1 (file surface):** `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` lies outside the claim's named list. **Answered — accepted.** The claim names "the generated form artifacts and baselines the gates name"; the count pin is a baseline over those bundles and moves by construction when a label row lands. The four bundles are the generated artifacts the claim names. The dev stopped and explained it in the report, as the claim required.
- **Deviation 2 (vitest `--` arg drop on the first spec run):** **Answered — no bearing.** The whole package ran either way; the result is a reporting detail, not a gate change.
